scope: Five previously published wiring findings and a focused lint omission control. Reverse dependencies use the unconfigured Bazel graph.

findings.title: Check typed-lint coverage when splitting a frontend package
findings.finding: The 22 child groups and the root glob supply all 328 tracked TypeScript and TSX files under agentplane/app/frontend. Removing the observability group from the query left 322. The six missing files include two specs.
findings.action: Use the set difference during package splits. It caught the simulated omission and found zero omissions on devel. Keep the existing whole-program ESLint test. Its generated declarations and external source inputs sit outside this file census.

findings.title: Measure one checker-only provider before changing image dependencies
findings.finding: Five eval-infra libraries declare the Anthropic, Claude and OpenAI providers beside the core library. af_chat_client directly imports the Anthropic and OpenAI clients. Haku’s agent also imports the OpenAI client. Those runtime imports rule out moving every provider to checker-only dependencies.
findings.action: Start with transcript, which imports only core symbols directly. Compare its Bazel runtime files and default mypy build with the Props prototype in PR #11497. Check a real consumer image before attributing any byte savings. The PR remains open at f0f596e8e2.

findings.title: Limit the Augur move to contracts used by its API
findings.finding: API configuration imports provider_config, state_space and trained_private_equity from x/models. Two other API modules import sample_sanity. Calibration imports private_equity_risk. The cluster documentation describes the service as parked.
findings.action: Defer a package move until Augur resumes development. If it resumes, migrate the API and calibration contracts with their config readers and exercise configured provider startup. The reviewed imports give a narrower scope than moving the experimental model tree.

findings.title: Keep the frozen benchmark inputs
findings.finding: The public HumanEval+ filegroup returned only itself in a depth-one reverse-dependency query across all workspace packages. A tracked exact-name search of the downstream repository also had zero matches. The run notes name all three input files directly.
findings.action: Leave the wrapper alone unless its public CLI entry point is explicitly retired. Removing one small filegroup has no demonstrated build-time benefit. Preserve the cohort, prompts and metadata.

findings.title: Closed · Haku’s exporter has a producer-owned dependency
findings.finding: The launch-routine exporter depends on haku/console/tools:routine. The former experimental service dependency disappeared with the Grocy preview move in #18051.
findings.action: Remove this refactor from the work list.
